name: Product Feed Synchronization & Disapproved Item Remediation
purpose: Synchronize and optimize product catalogs across Google Merchant Center, Meta Commerce Manager, and TikTok Shop/Catalog, resolving disapproved items and GTIN/MPN errors.
triggerConditions: New inventory or pricing catalog upload
prerequisites: Meta Commerce Manager Catalog ID connected
Source ecommerce XML/CSV feed URL or direct API sync active

executionSteps.name: Query Merchant Center Diagnostics
executionSteps.action: Fetch disapproved items, warnings, and missing attribute errors (GTIN, brand, price, shipping, availability) from GMC API

executionSteps.name: Query Meta Catalog Diagnostics
executionSteps.action: Check Meta Catalog items rejected for policy, missing description, low image resolution, or out-of-stock discrepancies

executionSteps.name: Query TikTok Catalog Status
executionSteps.action: Verify TikTok Video Shopping Ads catalog sync and currency formatting

executionSteps.name: Remediate Feed Formatting & Attributes
executionSteps.action: Generate feed supplement rules or mapped attributes to supply missing identifiers and correct tax/shipping formats

executionSteps.name: Re-submit Feed for Express Review
executionSteps.action: Trigger on-demand feed fetch and request re-review of remediated disapproved items

expectedOutputs: Catalog Health Report across Google, Meta, and TikTok
successCriteria: Disapproved product rate under 2% of total active inventory
Zero account-level Merchant Center suspension warnings
All approved items synchronized with live on-site prices and stock status

failureHandling.retryStrategy: Retry feed fetch request once after 15 minutes

rollbackStrategy: Restore previous valid feed mapping rules if new rules cause mass product disapprovals.
